items.t: What Could Citigroup (C) Gain From A $270 Million Stablecoin And AI Overhaul?

items.t: Citigroup (C) Redeems Preferred Stock Following An Undervalued But Tested Narrative
items.sum: Citigroup (C) has moved to redeem all US$1.0b of its 4.150% Series Y preferred stock, retiring 1,000,000 depositary shares at US$1,000 each and ending dividend accrual on November 15, 2026. Citigroup’s move to tidy up its capital stack comes after a mixed stretch for the common stock.
